name: Roanoke Colony
description: The Roanoke Colony, known as 'The Lost Colony,' was an English settlement of approximately 115–121 colonists established on Roanoke Island (present-day North Carolina) in 1587. When Governor John White returned in August 1590, the settlement was found completely abandoned, with only the word 'CROATOAN' carved into a post.

aliases.name: The Lost Colony
aliases.meaning: Common name for the 1587 English colony on Roanoke Island that disappeared by 1590

origin: Roanoke Island, present-day Dare County, North Carolina, United States. Archaeological investigation has extended to Hatteras Island (Croatoan Island) and a site 50 miles inland ('Site X' in Bertie County).
